cmd.help.title: 📚 Study Bridge · Commands
cmd.help.body:
Binding & identity
/bind <6-digit code>  link the App to this QQ account
/whoami  current principal and device count
/unbind <device label>  revoke a device
/addr  show the service address
/umo  show this session's UMO

Schedule
/today  today's schedule
/tomorrow  tomorrow's schedule
/week  this week
/add <natural language>  e.g. /add vocabulary tomorrow 3pm for 1 hour
/done <index or keyword>  mark done
/del <index>  delete a task

Plans
/plan new <goal>  draft a plan (preview only)
/apply  write the last plan into the schedule
/plan list  list plans
/plan show <id>  plan detail

Others
/report [week|month]  plain-text report
/export  export all data as JSON
/memory  show remembered facts
/forget <index>  delete a memory
/reset  clear this session's history
/settings  view or change your settings
cmd.bind.private_only: The bind code only works in a private chat. Please DM the bot with /bind <6-digit code>.
cmd.bind.ok:
✅ Bound! Tap "Finish binding" in the App. Your data stays on your machine.
Bound devices: {devices}

cmd.addr.enabled:
🌐 Service address: {url}
Use it in the App (LAN IP for local, domain for public).
cmd.addr.disabled:
🔌 http.enabled=false, so the web UI / App is off.
To use the App: enable http.enabled in the plugin config and reload.
QQ only? Ignore this - /add /today /plan /report all keep working.
